prompt: Your team just got a shock bill from the tracing backend after rolling out OpenTelemetry across a NestJS API — storage and indexing costs have exploded. Below is the current tracing setup: the SDK bootstrap and a per-request interceptor that instruments every incoming HTTP call. A teammate is blaming the OTLP exporter and wants to throttle it, but you're asked to actually diagnose the real cost driver and fix it without going blind on future latency investigations. Walk through what's wrong here and how you'd reshape the instrumentation.
